meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Implements Manus-style file-based planning to organize and track progress on complex tasks. Creates task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件规划并追踪多步骤复杂任务的进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要拆解并跟踪多步骤的复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Plan and track progress on multi-step complex tasks using files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down and track progress on complex multi-step tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为复杂任务创建三个 Markdown 文件（task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md）来规划步骤、记录发现和跟踪进度，并在每次决策前重新读取计划。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、分解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。也支持在 /clear 后自动恢复会话。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，比如搭建一个博客网站。
记录我刚刚找到的研究资料。
say.note: Claude 会将发现写入 findings.md。

say.text: 更新进度，我完成了第一阶段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates three Markdown files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) to plan steps, record findings, and track progress for complex tasks, and re-reads the plan before each decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Also supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-step project, like building a blog site.
say_en.note: Claude will create task_plan.md and other files to break down tasks.

say_en.text: Log the research findings I just discovered.
say_en.note: Claude will write findings into findings.md.

say_en.text: Update progress, I completed phase one.
say_en.note: Claude will update progress.md and mark the phase as complete.
